timeline.migration_2_0_homeload: Enphase Controller 2.0: this Enphase Home device is deprecated. It keeps working during the 2.0 migration window, but deprecated devices are planned for removal in 2.1.x (exact scope not decided yet). Please add the new Enphase Grid device, rebuild your Flows, then remove this device. Do not keep both for long: their energy totals would be counted twice in Homey Energy. Device history may be lost.

start.title: Connect your Envoy Gateway
start.subtitle: Connect to your gateway. Supports standard Owner accounts (read-only) or Installer/DIY accounts for system control.
start.error_required_fields: Please fill in all the required fields.
start.success_subtitle: Your Enphase account was validated and the local gateway was connected successfully.
start.desc_maintainer: Full control active. You can monitor production and toggle power generation on and off.
start.desc_owner: Read-only active. You can monitor production status, but power generation control is locked.
start.subtitle_homeload: Connect to your gateway to add the home consumption (P1 substitute) device.
start.warning_bypass_desc: You can ignore these warnings and continue adding the device, but some features may not work.
start.warning_not_metered: This gateway does not appear to be metered (no solar production EIM clamp detected). A substitute P1 meter device requires a metered gateway to fetch consumption data.
start.warning_no_consumption: Consumption monitoring is disabled or consumption clamps are not installed on this gateway. Home load data will not be available.
start.success_subtitle_homeload: Your Enphase account was validated and the home device is ready to be added.
start.subtitle_grid: Connect to your gateway to add grid import/export and home consumption (P1 substitute).
start.success_subtitle_grid: Your Enphase account was validated and the grid device is ready to be added.
start.serial_from_ip: Serial number read from the gateway at this IP address
start.serial_corrected: Serial number corrected to match the gateway at this IP address (__serial__)
start.serial_unreadable: Serial number could not be read from the gateway, please fill in manually.
start.reuse_device: Account details of an existing Enphase device on this gateway were found. Leave the password empty to reuse them.
start.reuse_snapshot: Saved settings from your previous device were found. Leave the password empty to reuse them.
start.reuse_cache: Your previously used Enphase account was found. Leave the password empty to reuse it.
start.warning_legacy_grid: An older Enphase Home device already exists for this gateway. Keeping both counts the same grid energy twice in Homey Energy. Rebuild your Flows with the new device, then remove the old Enphase Home device.
start.subtitle_battery: Connect to your gateway to add battery power, charge level and energy.
start.success_subtitle_battery: Your Enphase account was validated and the battery device is ready to be added.
start.warning_no_battery: No battery was detected on this gateway. You can still add the device, but it will not show any data until a battery is available.
start.warning_battery_unknown: Battery detection failed, so it is unknown whether a battery is installed. You can still add the device.
start.error_invalid_serial: Serial number must be exactly 12 digits (numbers only).
start.ip_auto_detected: IP auto detected on your network
start.ip_not_found: IP address of gateway can not be found on your network, please fill in manually.
start.serial_auto_detected: Serial number auto detected on your network
start.serial_not_found: Serial number of gateway can not be found on your network, please fill in manually.
start.repair_subtitle: Update your Enphase credentials or local Gateway IP address if they have changed.
start.warning_no_gridpower_but_homepower: Grid power monitoring (net-consumption) is not active, but home power consumption (total-consumption) is active. Homey can still track home load power.
start.warning_no_gridpower: Grid power monitoring (net-consumption) is not active or clamps are not installed on this gateway. Homey will not be able to track main grid import/export.

migration.step_flows: 4. Rebuild your Flows with the new Enphase Solar device.
